Settings

Display
Sofia Sans Extra Condensed OFL · headers and column titles
Text
Sofia Sans OFL
Mono
Sofia Sans Semi Condensed OFL · table cells (tabular figures, no mono needed)
Moves
condensed, tight setting, width as hierarchy
Mood
busy, exact, operational, calm under load
Case
Column titles in capitals (condensed, +0.03 em); everything else sentence case.
Numerals and features
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums

07:42 · 11:08 · 3 of 907:42 · 11:08 · 3 of 9

Times and counts line up in columns; the semi-condensed width saves a column on a laptop.
Signature
One family in three widths sets the rank: extra condensed for titles and headers, semi condensed for cells, normal for prose. Dense, but every row breathes at 1.3.
Use when
Operations dashboards, dispatch, logistics, support queues, trading screens, admin tables.
Turns into slop when
When a landing page borrows it to look "data-driven", when KPI tiles with giant numbers sit on top, or when every row gets a coloured pill.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
